greet-api.description: Python service: GraphQL API (schema + resolvers) and USER_GREETED webhook events

web-app.description: TypeScript web app: uses greet-lib and queries the API

mail-app.description: TypeScript app that reacts to webhook events

nobuild.description: web-app has no build config (no package.json, no tsconfig): it cannot be type-checked

stale.description: graphs published from base; afterwards web-app adds a farewell query and does not republish
